senses.gloss: m. (βήρυλλος) beryll, a precious stone, prob. the Chrysoberyll or yellow emerald (h. שֹׁהַם).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:9">Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:20">20</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 5:14">Targ. Cant. V, 14</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="B00728"><he>בִּרְלָא</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="B00378"><he>בּוּרְלִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:4">Targ. Esth. I, 4</cite>.—V. <cite ref="B00707"><he>בֵּירוּלִין</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 39:13">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIX, 13</cite> <he>בּוּרְלַת חַלָּא</he> sand-colored beryll.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 39:13">Ib.</cite> (I) XXVIII, 20 <he>ובירליות חלא</he>, prob. to be read <he>בירולין דחלא</he>; Ib. (II) <cite ref="B00121"><he>בדולחא</he></cite> (corr. acc.). [<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 38">Ex. R. s. 38</cite>, end <cite ref="Q01539"><he>פראלוקין</he></cite>, prob. a corrupt. of our w., cmp. LXX].
